title: Pectin-rich purple passion fruit mesocarp/agarose: film properties and impact of coatings on banana preservation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21320-21332
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09755J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bao-Tran Pham-Tran, Nhu-Quynh Thi Nguyen, Nhu-Ngoc Quynh Nguyen, Long Giang Bach, Thuong Thi Nguyen
This study is the first to optimize agarose concentration in pectin-rich matrices derived from purple passion fruit mesocarp for functional coating films and to apply them in prolonging the shelf life of bananas.
